Getting started with support

The fastest route to an answer depends on what you need. Order and delivery questions are handled by the workshop office during opening hours; specification and finish questions go to the maker who built your piece, which can take a little longer.

Before you get in touch, have your order number to hand. It appears on your confirmation email and on the delivery note, and it lets us pull the exact specification you approved rather than working from a description.

  • Order status and changes
  • Delivery windows and rescheduling
  • Caring for an oiled finish
  • Warranty and repairs

If none of those cover it, the contact page has the workshop phone number, address and opening hours.
